budget.prices: configured USD per million; unknown billing retains conservative full-context/output reservation
budget.limitation: Local accounting bound under configured prices, not a provider-enforced account spending limit

development.old_480_records_role: historical only, incompatible final interface; not silently adapted

common_delivery: Frozen N4 schema and provider success, no terminal artificial ceiling binding; same rule all regimes
dag_prompt: existing frozen E4 N1-N4 prompts, real chain execution; final validator identical

metrics.Q: frozen E4 deterministic 17 + disclosed Qwen-only 23; keep stratum-specific endpoints
metrics.C: sum actual known generation costs; unknown-billing upper bounds flagged
metrics.T: sum generation service + retry backoff + separately measured routing overhead; shared experimental queue excluded and not called wall-clock end-to-end
metrics.normalization_source: unchanged E3 constants, applied to full workflow rather than per-node; saturation reported without retuning
metrics.judge_cost: in total budget, excluded from policy-serving cost

training.features: same frozen observable request numeric fields + candidate model + node; no runtime state
training.DAG_target: observed final-trajectory utility for node-specific action predictor; association-based model, not identified causal node advantage
training.tuning: none; all targets and parameters frozen before new development outputs
training.policy_evaluation: OOF policies frozen then real execution; no simulated counterfactual concatenation

validation: Development only until independent task-group exposure audit completed; old internal holdout has historical responses for 20/20 IDs
stateaware: no expansion; no reuse of invalid Phase-D OPE estimators
